big: Midcaps sit between giants and small fry. The Nifty Midcap 50 shows how mid-sized companies move. It has a higher P/E and a stronger five-year return than the Nifty 50. Higher valuation and bigger swings often go together.

lines: What does the Nifty Midcap 50 actually track?

It captures the midcap segment. It picks the top 50 by six-month average free float market capitalisation from the Nifty Midcap 150. Weights follow free float market capitalisation. It is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.
